name: Glyphic Memorandum
summary: In Coldridge Valley, a memorandum calls novice mages to Anvilmar. Mountaineer Sten Stoutarm passes it to new arrivals, who are invited to meet its author, Marryk Nurribit, and begin their spellcraft studies.

sections.title: A Missive for Novice Mages
sections.body: Mountaineer Sten Stoutarm has a memorandum for the new mages he assists in Coldridge Valley. He hands it to you and advises you to read it, then go inside Anvilmar to meet the gnome who wrote it.

sections.title: Training with Marryk Nurribit
sections.body: Inside Anvilmar, gnome mage trainer Marryk Nurribit gives newcomers plain advice before teaching them. Stay out of serious trouble, save coin for training and tavern drinks, and keep clear of fallen Gnomeregan and its radioactive danger. Marryk is ready to teach you the arcane arts.

faq.answer: After you help mountaineer Sten Stoutarm with his early duties in Coldridge Valley, he hands you the memorandum.
Marryk Nurribit is a gnome mage trainer inside Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley. He teaches new mages their early spells and how to practice arcane arts safely.

faq.q: Where can I find Marryk Nurribit?
aliases: where is the mage trainer in coldridge valley
faq.answer: You can find Marryk Nurribit inside Anvilmar's main hall, at the top of Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh.

faq.q: Why does Marryk warn against visiting Gnomeregan?
faq.answer: Troggs overran Gnomeregan, and a catastrophic release of radioactive gas contaminated it. The city is perilous for a novice wandering Dun Morogh.
New mages beginning their studies in Coldridge Valley receive the memorandum to meet their class trainer.

faq.q: What does Marryk expect from his students?
faq.answer: Marryk advises his students to stay out of trouble, save silver for spell training and an ale for him, and keep away from Gnomeregan.

angles.text: As a mage, you meet your first arcane trainer in Dun Morogh through this memorandum.
As a gnome, you can learn from Marryk Nurribit, one of the gnome specialists who took refuge in dwarven lands after Gnomeregan fell.
As an Alliance member, you see dwarves and gnomes working together through Sten Stoutarm and Marryk Nurribit in Coldridge Valley.
